title: Red Warrior Pose Sequence
description: Four sequential poses of the same female character with long dark hair and red outfit, progressing from a high kick to a powerful ground stomp that creates red impact sparks. She wears a tattered red dress, black corset, gloves, and boots with a flowing red cape.
prompt: A female character with long flowing dark hair in a high ponytail, wearing a revealing tattered red dress with black corset, red cape, black gloves and heavy boots, shown in four progressive action poses from left to right: high knee kick, mid kick, preparing stomp, and powerful ground stomp creating red sparks and impact effect, consistent character design, clean white background, anime influenced digital art style
